authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6459 *duvāra explicitly gives Kumauni dwār and Western Pahari dwār in its addenda, as well as Nepali duwār. Dotyali dvār/dvər therefore selects that expanded door family, preserving the local reduced vowel; the separate dvāra branch mainly supplies dār/bār forms. Exact survey response: dvər.
